parameter_rules.window_start_utc: UTC YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss; inclusive; keep ordinary evidence window <=1 hour
parameter_rules.window_end_utc: UTC YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss; exclusive; >=start and <=1 hour after start unless the exact run duration requires widening
parameter_rules.row_offset: Non-negative integer in steps of 500 for all six paginated queries, including lookup_trace_by_ids. Start at 0; keep every page until a page has fewer than 500 rows. Keep the exact IDs and UTC window fixed; reconcile row/UUID/span counts under pagination_review.execution_rules before accepting completeness.
parameter_rules.run_id: Empty or Mikka telemetryId-safe opaque ID, <=128 characters
parameter_rules.thread_id: Empty or Mikka telemetryId-safe opaque ID, <=128 characters
parameter_rules.task_id: Empty or Mikka telemetryId-safe opaque ID, <=128 characters
parameter_rules.session_id: Real browser session ID; metadata alone never substitutes for browser playback proof

queries.lookup_trace_by_ids:
SELECT lower(hex(base64Decode(trace_id))) AS trace_id_hex,
    formatDateTime(min(timestamp), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%S.%fZ', 'UTC') AS started_utc, formatDateTime(max(end_time), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%S.%fZ', 'UTC') AS ended_utc,
    groupUniqArray(service_name) AS services, uniqExact(span_id) AS observed_span_ids,
    groupUniqArray(nullIf(attributes['mikka.run_id'], '')) AS run_ids,
    groupUniqArray(nullIf(attributes['mikka.thread_id'], '')) AS thread_ids,
    groupUniqArray(nullIf(attributes['mikka.task_id'], '')) AS task_ids
FROM posthog.trace_spans
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('{{window_start_utc}}', 'UTC')
      AND timestamp < toDateTime('{{window_end_utc}}', 'UTC')
    AND service_name IN ('mikka-web', 'mikka-daemon')
    AND coalesce(nullIf(resource_attributes['deployment.environment.name'], ''), resource_attributes['deployment.environment']) = 'production'
    AND (
        ('{{run_id}}' != '' AND attributes['mikka.run_id'] = '{{run_id}}')
        OR ('{{thread_id}}' != '' AND attributes['mikka.thread_id'] = '{{thread_id}}')
        OR ('{{task_id}}' != '' AND attributes['mikka.task_id'] = '{{task_id}}')
    )
GROUP BY trace_id
ORDER BY min(timestamp), trace_id
LIMIT 500 OFFSET {{row_offset}}

queries.span_timeline:
WITH selected_spans AS (
    SELECT timestamp, end_time, uuid, trace_id, span_id, parent_span_id, is_root_span,
        service_name, name, duration_nano, status_code, attributes, resource_attributes
    FROM posthog.trace_spans
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('{{window_start_utc}}', 'UTC')
      AND timestamp < toDateTime('{{window_end_utc}}', 'UTC')
      AND service_name IN ('mikka-web', 'mikka-daemon')
      AND coalesce(nullIf(resource_attributes['deployment.environment.name'], ''), resource_attributes['deployment.environment']) = 'production'
      AND trace_id = base64Encode(unhex('{{trace_id_hex}}'))
)
SELECT formatDateTime(s.timestamp, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%S.%fZ', 'UTC') AS started_utc, toString(s.uuid) AS span_row_uuid,
    dateDiff('microsecond', min(s.timestamp) OVER (), s.timestamp) / 1000 AS offset_ms,
    s.duration_nano / 1000000 AS duration_ms, s.service_name AS service,
    s.name AS stage, nullIf(s.attributes['mikka.workflow'], '') AS workflow,
    nullIf(s.attributes['mikka.step'], '') AS workflow_step,
    lower(hex(base64Decode(s.span_id))) AS span_id_hex, lower(hex(base64Decode(s.parent_span_id))) AS parent_span_id_hex,
    parent_span.name AS parent_stage,
    multiIf(s.is_root_span, 'root', length(coalesce(parent_span.span_id, '')) > 0, 'observed_parent', 'external_or_missing_parent') AS parent_presence,
    s.status_code,
    nullIf(s.attributes['mikka.run_id'], '') AS run_id,
    nullIf(s.attributes['mikka.thread_id'], '') AS thread_id,
    nullIf(s.attributes['mikka.task_id'], '') AS task_id,
    nullIf(s.attributes['mikka.workflow_run_id'], '') AS workflow_run_id,
    nullIf(s.attributes['sessionId'], '') AS session_id
FROM selected_spans AS s
LEFT ANY JOIN selected_spans AS parent_span
    ON s.trace_id = parent_span.trace_id AND s.parent_span_id = parent_span.span_id
ORDER BY s.timestamp, s.span_id, s.uuid
LIMIT 500 OFFSET {{row_offset}}

    toFloatOrNull(toString(properties['mikka.ai.tier_confidence'])) AS tier_confidence,

    nullIf(toString(properties['mikka.ai.timing_basis']), '') AS timing_basis,
    nullIf(toString(properties['mikka.ai.ttft_basis']), '') AS ttft_basis,
    nullIf(toString(properties['mikka.ai.model_basis']), '') AS model_basis,
    nullIf(toString(properties['mikka.ai.native_unavailable_reason']), '') AS native_unavailable_reason,
    toFloatOrNull(toString(properties['mikka.ai.first_output_item_ms'])) AS first_output_item_ms,
    toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.$ai_input_tokens)) AS input_tokens,
    toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.$ai_output_tokens)) AS output_tokens,
    toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.$ai_cache_read_input_tokens)) AS cache_read_tokens,
    toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.$ai_cache_creation_input_tokens)) AS cache_creation_tokens,
    nullIf(toString(properties.$ai_cache_reporting_exclusive), '') AS cache_reporting_exclusive_raw,
    1000 * toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.$ai_latency)) AS latency_ms,
    1000 * toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.$ai_time_to_first_token)) AS ttft_ms,
    toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.$ai_total_cost_usd)) AS total_cost_usd,
    nullIf(toString(properties.$ai_cost_passthrough), '') AS cost_passthrough_raw,
    nullIf(toString(properties.$ai_cost_model_source), '') AS cost_model_source,
    nullIf(toString(properties.$ai_model_cost_used), '') AS cost_model_used,
    nullIf(toString(properties.$ai_cost_model_provider), '') AS cost_model_provider,
    multiIf(isNull(toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.$ai_total_cost_usd))), 'unknown',
        toString(properties.$ai_cost_passthrough) IN ('1', 'true'), 'captured_per_call_amount',
        toString(properties.$ai_cost_model_source) IN ('openrouter', 'manual'), 'catalog_api_equivalent_estimate',
        toString(properties.$ai_cost_model_source) = 'custom', 'custom_api_equivalent_estimate',
        'amount_with_unverified_provenance') AS cost_basis,
    toString(properties.$ai_is_error) IN ('1', 'true') AS is_error,
    nullIf(toString(properties['mikka.ai.outcome']), '') AS server_outcome,
    coalesce(nullIf(toString(properties.$session_id), ''), nullIf(toString(properties.$ai_session_id), '')) AS session_id,
    nullIf(toString(properties['mikka.run_id']), '') AS run_id,
    nullIf(toString(properties['mikka.thread_id']), '') AS thread_id,
    nullIf(toString(properties['mikka.task_id']), '') AS task_id
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('{{window_start_utc}}', 'UTC')
    AND timestamp < toDateTime('{{window_end_utc}}', 'UTC')
    AND event = '$ai_generation' AND properties.$ai_trace_id = '{{trace_id_hex}}'
ORDER BY timestamp, uuid
LIMIT 500 OFFSET {{row_offset}}

queries.replay_correlation:
WITH recording AS (
    SELECT session_id, count() AS recording_chunks,
        min(min_first_timestamp) AS started_at, max(max_last_timestamp) AS ended_at,
        sum(size) AS recorded_bytes, sum(event_count) AS replay_events,
        sum(console_log_count) AS console_logs, sum(console_warn_count) AS console_warnings,
        sum(console_error_count) AS console_errors, max(is_deleted) AS deleted
    FROM raw_session_replay_events
    WHERE session_id = '{{session_id}}'
        AND min_first_timestamp >= toDateTime('{{window_start_utc}}', 'UTC') - INTERVAL 1 DAY
        AND min_first_timestamp < toDateTime('{{window_end_utc}}', 'UTC')
        AND max_last_timestamp >= toDateTime('{{window_start_utc}}', 'UTC')
    GROUP BY session_id
),
ai_sessions AS (
    SELECT toString(properties.$session_id) AS session_id, uniqExact(uuid) AS correlated_generations
    FROM events
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('{{window_start_utc}}', 'UTC')
    AND timestamp < toDateTime('{{window_end_utc}}', 'UTC')
        AND event = '$ai_generation' AND properties.$ai_trace_id = '{{trace_id_hex}}'
        AND properties.$session_id = '{{session_id}}'
    GROUP BY session_id
)
SELECT wanted.session_id, coalesce(recording.recording_chunks, 0) AS recording_chunks,
    coalesce(recording.recorded_bytes, 0) AS recorded_bytes, coalesce(recording.replay_events, 0) AS replay_events,
    if(coalesce(recording.recording_chunks, 0) > 0, formatDateTime(recording.started_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%S.%fZ', 'UTC'), NULL) AS recording_started_utc,
    if(coalesce(recording.recording_chunks, 0) > 0, formatDateTime(recording.ended_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%S.%fZ', 'UTC'), NULL) AS recording_ended_utc,
    if(coalesce(recording.recording_chunks, 0) > 0, recording.deleted, NULL) AS deleted,
    recording.console_logs, recording.console_warnings, recording.console_errors,
    coalesce(ai_sessions.correlated_generations, 0) AS correlated_generations
FROM (SELECT '{{session_id}}' AS session_id) AS wanted
LEFT ANY JOIN recording ON wanted.session_id = recording.session_id
LEFT ANY JOIN ai_sessions ON wanted.session_id = ai_sessions.session_id

    countIf(toString(properties.$ai_cache_reporting_exclusive) IN ('0', 'false')) AS cache_inclusive_rows,
    countIf(toString(properties.$ai_cache_reporting_exclusive) IN ('1', 'true')) AS cache_exclusive_rows,
    countIf(coalesce(toString(properties.$ai_cache_reporting_exclusive), '') NOT IN ('0', 'false', '1', 'true')) AS cache_semantics_unknown_rows,
    countIf(isNotNull(toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.$ai_latency)))) AS with_latency,
    countIf(isNotNull(toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.$ai_time_to_first_token)))) AS with_ttft,
    countIf(toString(properties['mikka.ai.timing_basis']) = 'official_cli_trace') AS native_request_generations,
    countIf(toString(properties['mikka.ai.timing_basis']) = 'app_server_usage') AS app_server_fallback_generations,
    groupUniqArray(nullIf(toString(properties['mikka.ai.ttft_basis']), '')) AS ttft_bases,
    groupUniqArray(nullIf(toString(properties['mikka.ai.native_unavailable_reason']), '')) AS native_unavailable_reasons,
    countIf(isNotNull(toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.$ai_total_cost_usd))) AND toString(properties.$ai_cost_passthrough) IN ('1', 'true')) AS captured_per_call_cost_rows,
    countIf(isNotNull(toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.$ai_total_cost_usd))) AND coalesce(toString(properties.$ai_cost_passthrough), '') NOT IN ('1', 'true') AND toString(properties.$ai_cost_model_source) IN ('openrouter', 'manual')) AS catalog_api_estimate_rows,
    countIf(isNotNull(toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.$ai_total_cost_usd))) AND coalesce(toString(properties.$ai_cost_passthrough), '') NOT IN ('1', 'true') AND toString(properties.$ai_cost_model_source) = 'custom') AS custom_api_estimate_rows,
    countIf(isNotNull(toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.$ai_total_cost_usd))) AND coalesce(toString(properties.$ai_cost_passthrough), '') NOT IN ('1', 'true') AND coalesce(toString(properties.$ai_cost_model_source), '') NOT IN ('openrouter', 'manual', 'custom')) AS unverified_cost_provenance_rows,
    groupUniqArray(nullIf(toString(properties.$ai_cost_passthrough), '')) AS cost_passthrough_values,
    groupUniqArray(nullIf(toString(properties.$ai_cost_model_source), '')) AS cost_model_sources,
    groupUniqArray(nullIf(toString(properties.$ai_model_cost_used), '')) AS cost_models_used,
    groupUniqArray(nullIf(toString(properties.$ai_cost_model_provider), '')) AS cost_model_providers,
    countIf(isNull(toFloatOrNull(toString(properties.$ai_total_cost_usd)))) AS unknown_cost_rows
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('{{window_start_utc}}', 'UTC')
    AND timestamp < toDateTime('{{window_end_utc}}', 'UTC')
    AND event = '$ai_generation' AND properties.$ai_trace_id = '{{trace_id_hex}}'
queries.apm_session_links:
WITH selected_spans AS (
    SELECT timestamp, end_time, trace_id, span_id, parent_span_id, is_root_span,
        service_name, name, duration_nano, status_code, attributes, resource_attributes
    FROM posthog.trace_spans
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('{{window_start_utc}}', 'UTC')
      AND timestamp < toDateTime('{{window_end_utc}}', 'UTC')
      AND service_name IN ('mikka-web', 'mikka-daemon')
      AND coalesce(nullIf(resource_attributes['deployment.environment.name'], ''), resource_attributes['deployment.environment']) = 'production'
      AND trace_id = base64Encode(unhex('{{trace_id_hex}}'))
)
SELECT attributes['sessionId'] AS session_id, service_name AS service,
    uniqExact(span_id) AS correlated_span_ids,
    groupUniqArray(nullIf(attributes['mikka.run_id'], '')) AS run_ids,
    groupUniqArray(nullIf(attributes['mikka.task_id'], '')) AS task_ids
FROM selected_spans
WHERE length(coalesce(attributes['sessionId'], '')) > 0
GROUP BY session_id, service_name
ORDER BY session_id, service_name
queries.native_generation_collection:
WITH selected_spans AS (
    SELECT timestamp, end_time, uuid, trace_id, span_id, parent_span_id, is_root_span,
        service_name, name, duration_nano, status_code, attributes, resource_attributes
    FROM posthog.trace_spans
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('{{window_start_utc}}', 'UTC')
      AND timestamp < toDateTime('{{window_end_utc}}', 'UTC')
      AND service_name IN ('mikka-web', 'mikka-daemon')
      AND coalesce(nullIf(resource_attributes['deployment.environment.name'], ''), resource_attributes['deployment.environment']) = 'production'
      AND trace_id = base64Encode(unhex('{{trace_id_hex}}'))
)
SELECT formatDateTime(timestamp, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%S.%fZ', 'UTC') AS emitted_utc, toString(uuid) AS span_row_uuid,
    lower(hex(base64Decode(span_id))) AS collection_span_id_hex,
    lower(hex(base64Decode(parent_span_id))) AS parent_span_id_hex,
    nullIf(attributes['mikka.run_id'], '') AS run_id,
    nullIf(attributes['mikka.thread_id'], '') AS thread_id,
    nullIf(attributes['mikka.task_id'], '') AS task_id,
    nullIf(attributes['mikka.workflow_run_id'], '') AS workflow_run_id,
    nullIf(attributes['sessionId'], '') AS session_id,
    nullIf(attributes['mikka.harness'], '') AS harness,
    nullIf(attributes['mikka.ai.native_unavailable_reason'], '') AS native_unavailable_reason,
    toFloatOrNull(attributes['mikka.trace.sample_rate']) AS sample_rate,
    toFloatOrNull(attributes['mikka.ai.native_generations']) AS native_generations,
    toFloatOrNull(attributes['mikka.ai.fallback_generations']) AS fallback_generations,
    toFloatOrNull(attributes['mikka.ai.matched_fallbacks']) AS matched_fallbacks,
    toFloatOrNull(attributes['mikka.ai.missing_native']) AS missing_native,
    toFloatOrNull(attributes['mikka.ai.incomplete_requests']) AS incomplete_requests,
    toFloatOrNull(attributes['mikka.ai.invalid_spans']) AS invalid_spans,
    toFloatOrNull(attributes['mikka.ai.rejected_batches']) AS rejected_batches,
    toFloatOrNull(attributes['mikka.ai.duplicate_completions']) AS duplicate_completions,
    nullIf(attributes['mikka.ai.collection_truncated'], '') AS collection_truncated_raw,
    nullIf(attributes['mikka.ai.cli_exit_observed'], '') AS cli_exit_observed_raw,
    nullIf(attributes['mikka.ai.native_flush_confirmed'], '') AS native_flush_confirmed_raw
FROM selected_spans
WHERE service_name = 'mikka-daemon' AND name = 'daemon.ai.collection'
ORDER BY timestamp, span_id, uuid
LIMIT 500 OFFSET {{row_offset}}

notes: No live dashboard/insight/export has been created by this preparation.
Baseline trace is only a SQL/schema compatibility fixture; never label it production acceptance for issue 1512.
No SELECT of prompt, output, tool arguments, arbitrary log bodies, URL fields or full properties/maps.
AI token/cache fields and TTFT/cost preserve unknown as NULL. Cache input counts are not additive to input tokens when cache_reporting_exclusive=false.

posthog-js tracing_headers guarantees X-POSTHOG-SESSION-ID and X-POSTHOG-DISTINCT-ID, not necessarily W3C traceparent. Inspect the real browser server entry; only the API acceptance driver explicitly creates an unexported W3C remote parent. Missing internal ancestors remain a defect.
Tail-retention query is scoped to mikka-web ordinary error/slow trace. Legacy/missing sample rates are not silently treated as full retention.
Replay uses raw recording metadata/bytes/events and trace-correlated real session ID. Require fresh actual browser evidence separately; never reuse an old recording as the current run.
Use current native URLs returned by apm-trace-get/query-llm-trace/query-logs or generate-app-url. Native APM observed route is /tracing?trace=<hex>. Do not guess per-span UI routes.

Live validation found APM/Logs on Logs cluster and events/Replay on Default cluster: HogQL cannot JOIN or UNION across these clusters. Verify cross-cluster correlation by exact hex trace_id + span_id/session_id sets from separate bounded query results; saved dashboard keeps these as separate tiles.

Current linking-errors-to-traces skill confirms query-logs filterGroup trace_id uses the validated HEX value (type=log, operator=exact), while raw logs.trace_id is base64. Scope by discovered services plus exact UTC window and take _posthogUrl from the native query response.

Cost basis preserves the raw passthrough/source/model/provider fields. Passthrough with an amount is captured_per_call_amount, not proof of an actual subscription charge; known openrouter/manual and custom sources are labelled separately as API-equivalent estimates. An amount without verified provenance remains explicitly unverified.

The AI event is authoritative for cache_reporting_exclusive and provider. Web generation APM spans currently omit mikka.ai.provider; daemon generation spans contain it. An empty web APM provider is not a missing AI event. Daemon AI events omit mikka.ai.outcome; read their APM mikka.outcome and $ai_is_error instead of treating server_outcome NULL as failure.

The native collection query returns only exported closed counters/flags. batches and spansReceived exist only in the in-memory collector receipt and are not exported; do not query invented attributes for them.
Raw cache provenance means the numeric mapping from the SDK raw usage receipt, not retrieval of raw provider payloads. No query selects raw usage, message/tool content or complete properties/maps.

Native/fallback counts concern observed request receipts, not a claim that the official CLI exporter flushed every request. native_flush_confirmed remains false by design. Claude currently has no independent per-child generation-count receipt; matching its AI/APM sets alone does not prove upstream completeness.

Missing route/tier/score/confidence or native effort remains NULL where that path has no corresponding receipt. Codex effort is native selected/default configuration and model_basis is requested sampling configuration, not a provider-served attestation.

Pagination revision: baseline_validation and live_schema_preflight are preserved verbatim and bind only their historical SQL text, retained in production-evidence-query-templates.pre-pagination.json. The five changed query texts listed in pagination_review have not been live-compiled or executed; their first read on the actual trace must confirm SQL/schema compatibility before any acceptance claim.

All six paginated queries use 500-row pages. lookup_trace_by_ids orders by aggregate first timestamp and the unique trace_id; row-level queries end their ORDER BY with the actual storage uuid. generation_receipts already did so. safe_native_logs exposes log_uuid; all three APM detail queries expose span_row_uuid separately from the unchanged logical span ID, so the executor can count physical UUIDs and detect repeated rows across pages.

The evidence executor must compare both AI-to-APM and APM-to-AI generation ID differences for each exact trace, then group by operation/model/harness. Trace-wide count equality cannot substitute for equal sets, equal parentage and matching reported usage. Preserve null metadata and include built-in Decision calls, not only the two selected agent models.

Do not accept OFFSET pagination while late ingestion is changing the selected dataset. After the business run/owned-child cleanup is terminal, hold a fixed UTC window, obtain all pages, and reconcile the aggregate counts and discovered ID sets before/after collection. A change leaves evidence incomplete until a stable read can be obtained; it does not authorize another model execution.

Reconcile physical rows separately from event/log/span-row UUIDs and logical span IDs. Generation event rows/UUIDs/span IDs must match ai_capture_summary; timeline rows/distinct span IDs must match trace_integrity; unique log_uuid values must match capture_summary.native_log_rows. Tally span_row_uuid and repeated UUIDs independently in each APM detail result. Derive expected generation/collection span-ID and span_row_uuid subsets from the complete timeline and compare both ways with their paginated detail queries.

Pagination proves only completeness of retrieved evidence. Claude still has no independent per-child upstream generation count, and native_flush_confirmed=false remains an unconfirmed official CLI flush. Missing collection rows/counters, incomplete/truncated/rejected native receipts, or missing native timing must not become zero or a complete-upstream claim.

scouts.check_description: Live readback during this preparation on 2026-11-06: both enabled/active/emit; interval 1440 min, default precheck, Inbox only.

correlation_checks: Every AI $ai_span_id must occur in apm_generation_spans.span_id_hex for the same trace; match model/usage and compare parent span IDs; compare provider only where the APM span emits it, otherwise use the explicit AI event provider.
Both safe_native_logs.trace_id_hex and span_id_hex must match native APM IDs; safe_body_shape must remain true.
Use a real browser session ID from current request headers. Compare apm_session_links with generation_receipts session_id and replay_correlation actual bytes/events; no invented session identifier.

Compare trace_integrity distinct_span_ids with paginated span_timeline and apm-trace-get total/page count; inspect actual browser/server parentage and distinguish a known API-driver remote parent from missing internal ancestors.

Current failure trace's web tail retention must contain real failure/slow evidence, full_rate rows equal all relevant observed spans, zero missing/nonfull rates; external execution receipt establishes which deliberate failure was exercised.

For each Codex run, sum distinct native_generation_collection rows after pagination. Intended generation emissions = native_generations + fallback_generations; observed app-server request receipts = matched_fallbacks + fallback_generations. Compare intended emissions with both distinct daemon.ai.generation span IDs and distinct $ai_generation span IDs for that run/harness. Do not count matched_fallbacks again as generations.

For complete native timing coverage require no fallback/missing-native, no incomplete requests, no invalid spans or rejected batches, no collection truncation and observed CLI exit. A missing collection row or unknown count is not zero. duplicate_completions may be nonzero only while unique generation sets remain equal; native_flush_confirmed=false never becomes a flush guarantee.

Native Codex latency must agree with its APM native start/end interval within timestamp conversion precision (at most 1 ms), and TTFT must equal first_output_item_ms with request_to_first_output_item basis and satisfy 0 <= TTFT <= latency. Never substitute app-server receipt arrival time or enclosing tool-drain duration.

Across the selected trace, reconcile all operation/model buckets, including Coordinator/bot and built-in Decision, instead of filtering all evidence to only the user-selected agent model. Expected native runs are Factory-stage counts, not an expected model-generation count.

For every receipt that includes cache semantics require cache_reporting_exclusive_raw in (0,false). Compare event/APM input/output/cache counts exactly; 0 is a reported count and NULL remains unavailable. Cache buckets are included in input, never added twice.

Cost summary partitions amount-bearing rows into captured-per-call, known catalogue estimate, custom estimate and unverified provenance; rows without amounts remain unknown. Read exact model/provider and pricing match fields for both target models before making any cost-accuracy claim.

execution_rules.lookup: Require at least one actual run_id/thread_id/task_id, paginate all 500-row pages, and process every distinct discovered trace_id; never silently select only the first trace. Empty or unstable lookup results do not establish missing or complete telemetry.
execution_rules.fixed_scope: Use exact verified IDs and one fixed UTC [start,end) window covering the real submission through terminal cleanup/collection. Do not use baseline IDs or slide the window between pages; if the window must be corrected, recollect all pages and summaries with that same corrected window.
execution_rules.stable_ingestion: Business terminal/CLI exit alone does not establish completed ingestion. Retain the before/after aggregate counts and discovered UUID/span/trace/session sets; any change or paging inconsistency leaves collection incomplete and requires a stable re-read of evidence, never a provider retry.
execution_rules.row_counts: Compare fetched generation rows, unique event_uuid and unique generation span IDs to all three ai_capture_summary counts. Compare timeline rows and unique span IDs to trace_integrity; separately tally span_row_uuid and repeated row UUIDs in all three APM detail results. Compare unique log_uuid to capture_summary.native_log_rows. Repeated row UUIDs across pages must be investigated as pagination/ingestion duplicates, not counted as another logical generation.
execution_rules.apm_subsets: From the full timeline, form both logical span-ID and physical span_row_uuid sets for mikka.ai.generation, daemon.ai.generation and daemon.ai.collection. Compare each set both ways with complete apm_generation_spans and native_generation_collection results; raw row counts, physical UUID counts and logical unique span counts remain separate.
execution_rules.bidirectional_generations: For each trace, AI span IDs minus APM generation span IDs and the reverse must both be empty. Check per-ID parentage, exact model, present provider, run/task/session links and each reported numeric usage field; do not substitute matching totals for matching identities.
execution_rules.buckets: Perform the same count/set checks by (operation, model, harness), preserving NULLs. Include Decision openai/gpt-6-luna-decisions and every observed Coordinator/bot/agent/compaction/title/profile bucket; fixed Factory run counts are not expected generation counts.
execution_rules.native_counts: For each Codex run/harness, sum counters once per unique collection_span_id_hex. Intended emissions equal native_generations+fallback_generations; observed app-server receipts equal matched_fallbacks+fallback_generations. Reconcile intended emissions with unique daemon generation spans and AI generation spans; unknown counts remain unknown.
execution_rules.capability_limits: Require real exported completeness counters and timing basis where applicable. Claude has no independent upstream count receipt; official native flush is unconfirmed even when cli_exit_observed is true. No row-set equality upgrades those limits into a claim that every upstream request was observed.
execution_rules.clusters: Execute APM/Logs on Logs and events/Replay on Default. Do exact-ID comparisons in the evidence executor; never add a cross-cluster SQL JOIN/UNION or select raw content.

enumeration_review.scope: One fixed-cardinality count of exactly the existing lookup GROUP BY trace_id relation, without its LIMIT/OFFSET.
enumeration_review.database_enumeration: Requires both stable snapshots, independent totals, original identities and bidirectional set checks; not upstream delivery or production acceptance.
